description: This file implements server-side logic for the user profile page in a SvelteKit application. It handles loading user profile data from a Django REST API, and updating the profile via API calls, including validation and data transformation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the user's profile data from the backend API and transforms it into a structure suitable for the frontend.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Handles form submission to update the user's profile, including validation, formatting, and API request to persist changes.

calls: apiRequest('/profile/', { method: 'PATCH', body: djangoData }, { cookies, org })
